# Device configuration

21 keys, read with `config_get --path <key>` and written with
`config_set --path <key> --value <v>` (or the listed command directly). `config_schema`
returns this table, with a hash, at run time.

| Key | Type | Range / values | Applied by | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scan.target_fps` | int | 1 – 120 | `set_scan_timing target_fps` | Matrix scan rate in frames per second. |
| `scan.settle_us` | int | 0 – 1000 | `set_scan_timing settle_us` | Settling delay after driving a column, before sampling. |
| `scan.send_every_n_frames` | int | 1 – 255 | `set_scan_timing send_every_n_frames` | Transmit one frame out of every N scanned. |
| `scan.raw_adc` | bool |  | `set_raw_adc enabled` | Include the unprocessed ADC block alongside calibrated levels. |
| `stream.buffer_enabled` | bool |  | `set_stream_buffer enabled` | Decouple scanning from transmission with a packet ring. |
| `stream.buffer_mode` | enum | `standard`, `extended` | `set_stream_buffer mode` | Ring depth preset. |
| `filter.enabled` | bool |  | `set_filter enabled` | Enable the median + low-pass filter chain. |
| `filter.median` | int | 1 – 5 | `set_filter median` | Median window size in samples. |
| `filter.alpha` | float | 0.05 – 0.6 | `set_filter alpha` | Low-pass smoothing factor. |
| `imu.enabled` | bool |  | `set_imu enabled` | Sample the IMU and attach it to outgoing frames. |
| `log.enabled` | bool |  | `set_log enabled` | Write the device log to flash. |
| `log.level` | enum | `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug` | `set_log level` | Global log verbosity. |
| `log.mode` | enum | `standard`, `extended` | `set_log mode` | Log file size budget. |
| `ota.auto_apply_on_boot` | bool |  | `set_ota_config auto_apply_on_boot` | Check for and apply a newer firmware during boot. |
| `ota.channel` | enum | `stable`, `beta` | `set_ota_config channel` | Update channel: stable (public releases) or beta (experimental). |
| `ota.manifest_url` | text |  | `set_ota_config manifest_url` | Custom release manifest; empty follows the update channel. |
| `power.profile` | enum | `performance`, `balanced`, `powersave` | `set_power_profile profile` | CPU frequency policy while idle. |
| `power.charge_profile` | enum | `compatible`, `fast` | `set_charge_profile profile` | Battery charge current preset. |
| `clock.ntp_server` | text |  | `set_clock_config ntp_server` | NTP server used in WiFi mode. |
| `clock.ntp_interval_s` | int | 60 – 86400 | `set_clock_config ntp_interval_s` | Seconds between NTP re-syncs (WiFi mode). |
| `clock.sync_interval_s` | int | 5 – 3600 | `set_clock_config sync_interval_s` | Seconds between time exchanges with the Gateway (WiFi) or Hub (ESP-NOW). |
